SELECT c.concert_id, c.title, c.artist, c.venue, c.thumbnail, c.status , TO_CHAR(MIN(s.booking_open_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS booking_start_at , TO_CHAR(MAX(s.booking_open_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS booking_end_at , TO_CHAR(MIN(s.performance_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS perform_start_at , TO_CHAR(MAX(s.performance_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS perform_end_at , COUNT(s.schedule_id) AS schedule_count FROM concerts c LEFT JOIN concert_schedules s ON c.concert_id = s.concert_id WHERE (LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%${keyword}%' OR LOWER(c.artist) LIKE '%${keyword}%' OR LOWER(c.venue) LIKE '%${keyword}%')
AND c.status = '${status}'
GROUP BY c.concert_id, c.title, c.artist, c.venue, c.thumbnail, c.status ORDER BY CASE c.status WHEN 'ONGOING' THEN 1 WHEN 'UPCOMING' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, c.concert_id DESC

SELECT schedule_id , concert_id , TO_CHAR(performance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS performance_date , TO_CHAR(NVL(booking_open_at, TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 00:00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS booking_open_at , total_seats , available_seats , TO_CHAR(performance_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS weekday , TO_CHAR(performance_date, 'HH24:MI') AS performance_time , CASE WHEN booking_open_at IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN booking_open_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS booking_openable , CASE WHEN performance_date < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS performance_ended FROM concert_schedules WHERE concert_id = #{concertId} AND performance_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY performance_date ASC
